name: Radiance-Predicting Neural Networks (RPNN)
definition: Uses radiance-predicting neural networks (RPNNs) for multiple scattering in atmospheric clouds. An RPNN represents radiance for each shading configuration including location, direction, light source, and density structure.
summary: Radiance-Predicting Neural Networks predict multiple scattering radiance for clouds using global shading configurations, offering path-tracing accuracy at a thousand times the speed.
